repairs.text: Sí, truca abans de venir. T’ho explicaré per telèfon. Aquest matí ja he comprovat la guitarra de préstec i només falta que la guardem a la funda.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce funda /ˈfun.də/ with stressed U and audible N followed by D: FUN-da, never funa or fona. Keep the adult male Elies voice; do not read this instruction.

repairs.text: De res, Biel. Espera, que t’aguanto la funda mentre hi poses el full... així... Fins dijous, i ja m’explicaràs com va l’assaig.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce funda /ˈfun.də/ with stressed U and audible N followed by D: FUN-da, never funa or fona. Keep the adult male Elies voice; do not read this instruction.

repairs.text: A aquesta sí. A les del final... Ai, he fet caure l’arbre de cartró! Sempre em queda al mig. És bonic, però el podríem posar dret al costat de la capsa, a la cadira.
repairs.pronunciation: Keep youthful male Biel/Puck. Catalan cartró ends with stressed O, /kərˈtɾo/, with no final N. Say cartró, never cartron. Keep the spontaneous surprise and all other words.
